# Bitroix Solution LLC

> Bitroix Solution LLC is a web development, AI chatbot, UI/UX design, data analytics, DevOps and digital marketing agency with offices in San Francisco and Karachi. 150+ projects delivered.

## Services

- [Web Development](/web-development): Custom websites and web apps built with React, Node and modern stacks.
- [AI Chatbots](/ai-chatbots): Conversational AI, voice agents and chatbot integration for support and sales.
- [UI/UX Design](/ui-ux-design): Product design, wireframes, prototypes and design systems.
- [Data Analytics](/data-analytics): Dashboards, data pipelines and business intelligence.
- [DevOps & MLOps](/devops-mlops): CI/CD, cloud infrastructure and ML deployment.
- [Team as a Service](/team-as-service): Dedicated engineering and design teams on demand.
- [Design Consultancy](/design-consultancy): Strategic design guidance for product and brand teams.

## Solutions

- [SEO Dominance](/solutions/seo-dominance): Keyword research, technical SEO, content and link building.
- [Lead Generation](/solutions/lead-generation): Multi-channel lead capture and nurture funnels.
- [Paid Ads Management](/solutions/paid-ads-management): Google, Meta and LinkedIn ad campaigns.
- [Marketing Automation](/solutions/marketing-automation): Email, CRM and workflow automation.
- [Conversion Optimization](/solutions/conversion-optimization): CRO testing to lift funnel performance.
- [Social Media Growth](/solutions/social-media-growth): Organic social strategy and content production.
